verdict.rationale: Vanta's developer docs describe first-party webhooks: you register an HTTP endpoint to receive real-time event notifications, verify them with Svix signatures, and handle retries instead of polling the API. This is direct, registrable outbound HTTP delivery that a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: no enumerated catalog of subscribable event types or payload schemas in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that delivery works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive real-time HTTP notifications when events happen in Vanta — register an endpoint, verify Svix signatures, and handle retries — instead of polling the API.
